damage.parameter_basis: Synthetic demonstration inputs, no fracture-energy or experimental calibration. Compression failure effectively disabled for this tensile example.

precrack.method: Rectangular_Plane bond filter; omitted bonds are not counted in subsequent Damage

validation.basis: Predeclared: bounded irreversible Damage, independent per-step bond-stretch history reconstruction, connectivity/boundary checks and advancing broken-bond indicator; no analytic fracture-path or experimental accuracy claim.

capability_scope: Synthetic thin-layer dynamic fracture demonstration with 3D Elastic constitutive law, not plane-stress calibration, a converged 3D specimen or an experimental prediction. No contact. Only the exact reviewed profile is supported.
